description: This file contains a test suite for Orleans grain activation lifecycle, specifically testing deactivation on idle behavior under various stress scenarios. It defines a test class with multiple test methods, helper methods for setup and grain management, and configuration classes for clients and silos.

classes.name: DeactivateOnIdleTests
classes.description: Test suite for grain deactivation behavior on idle, including stress scenarios, using Orleans testing infrastructure.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder with specific gateway options.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo host with custom options such as max forward count.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster, optionally with custom configuration.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Tears down the test cluster, ensuring all silos are stopped and resources disposed.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTestInside_Basic
methods.description: Tests grain deactivation and reactivation behavior within a basic scenario.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_1
methods.description: Performs stress testing by repeatedly deactivating and accessing grain state.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_2_NonReentrant
methods.description: Stress test with concurrent counter increments and deactivation, non-reentrant scenario.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_3_Reentrant
methods.description: Stress test with concurrent counter increments and deactivation, reentrant scenario.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_4_Timer
methods.description: Tests timer-based grain activity and deactivation.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_5
methods.description: Stress testing with concurrent counter increments and deactivation tasks.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdleTest_Stress_11
methods.description: Mass parallel grain method calls for stress testing.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_1
methods.description: Test deactivation behavior on a non-existent activation (group 0).

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_2
methods.description: Test deactivation behavior on a non-existent activation (group 1).

methods.name: DeactivationOnIdle_NonExistentActivation_Runner
methods.description: Helper method to run deactivation tests on a grain with a possibly non-existent or non-primary activation.

methods.name: PickGrainInNonPrimary
methods.description: Selects a grain whose primary silo is not the primary silo of the cluster for testing distributed activation handling.
